title: Feature request: Auto temp target when physical activity detected
body:
I am the type of person who spontaneously starts gardening or workouts. I forget to set my temp target to a higher value (7.8) for three hours...

When this happens I get low, then I eat sugar, and then I get high. It takes half a day before I have things under control.

Would it be possible to detect physical activity, and then suggest the user to increase temp target? (Or even automatically adjust the temp target)?

comments.body:
You can already do this if you use androidaps on a smartwatch.

https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Getting-Started/Watches.html#wear-os

You can send the stepcount or heartrate to androidaps and setup an automation in androidaps to trigger a change in temp target.
